Kidn@pping alert turns into child custody dispute, boy reunited with mother

A five-year-old boy reported as kidnapped was safely recovered after police intercepted a car following a Dial 112 alert. The investigation later revealed that the child had been taken away by his own father amid a matrimonial dispute.

The child's mother had reported that two men kidnapped her son, prompting police to track the vehicle through CCTV footage and intercept it in Bhadohi district.

Police later found that the mother had been living separately at her parental home, while the father claimed she had refused to return home or let him keep their son. He admitted taking the child himself.

After verifying the facts, police concluded it was a child custody dispute, not a kidnapping. The father was warned against taking the law into his own hands, and the child was handed back to the mother.
